Create a regular 2D grid with sixteen times as many grid cells as the desired number of points.
Visit each cell in turn in a left-to-right and top-to-bottom fashion.
Calculate potential $D_{i,j}$ using the function $D_{i,j} = (4D_{i-1,j} + D_{i-1,j-1} + 2D_{i,j-1} + D_{i+1,j-1}) / 8 + R$, where $R = \text{random}()$.
The system uses a 3-SLM projection engine where each SLM has 1-bit depth.
